---
title: "commot score plotting bar"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
df_cms = read.csv('../data/commotScores_spp1.csv')
df_cms = subset(df_cms, df_cms$acc != '15167')

df_cms$group = df_cms$MS
df_cms$group[df_cms$MS!= 'p53'] = 'non_p53'

df_cms = subset(df_cms, df_cms$annV7_noNum == 'Macrophage/DC')
df_cms$sumSR = (df_cms$s.SPP1)

# Ensure 'cn' is a factor for color mapping
df_cms$cn <- as.factor(df_cms$cn)
table(df_cms$group, df_cms$cn)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)  # for wilcox_effsize()

wilcox_table <- df_cms %>%
  group_by(cn) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(sumSR ~ group, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    n_control = sum(group == "p53"),
    n_disease = sum(group == "non_p53"),
    median_control = mean(sumSR[group == "p53"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_disease = mean(sumSR[group == "non_p53"], na.rm = TRUE),
    effect_size = tryCatch(
      wilcox_effsize(data.frame(group, sumSR), sumSR ~ group)$effsize,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)
View(wilcox_table)
```



########## some testing below

```{r}
library(ggridges)
df_cms$cn_plot <- as.character(df_cms$cn)
df_cms$cn_plot[!df_cms$cn_plot %in% c("4", "8", "9")] <- "other"

# Define global x-limits (quantile trimmed)
xlims <- quantile(df_cms$sumSR, probs = c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)

# Plot
plots <- df_cms %>%
  split(.$cn_plot) %>%
  lapply(function(df) {
    # Calculate group medians for this CN
    medians <- aggregate(sumSR ~ group, data = df, mean)

    ggplot(df, aes(x = sumSR, fill = group, color = group)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.3, position = "identity") +
      # Median lines for each group
      geom_vline(data = medians, aes(xintercept = sumSR, color = group),
                 linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("non_p53" = "#E64B35", "p53" = "#547AA5")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("non_p53" = "#E64B35", "p53" = "#547AA5")) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = xlims) +
      theme_classic() +
      ggtitle(paste("CN", unique(df$cn_plot))) +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  })

library(patchwork)
p = wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
ggsave('../plots/SPP1_lrscores_mph.svg', width = 6, height = 5)
p
```


```{r}

xlims <- quantile(df_cms$sumSR, probs = c(0.01, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)

      scale_fill_manual(values = c("non_p53" = "#E64B35", "p53" = "#547AA5")) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = xlims) +

```


```{r}
df_cms$sum = (df_cms$s.IGF2.IGFBP5 + df_cms$r.IGF2.IGFBP5)

df_sum <- df_cms %>%
  group_by(tma_fov, annV7_noNum, group) %>%
  summarise(sum_acc = mean(sum), .groups = 'drop')

# Create the barplot with error bars
df_sum = subset(df_sum, df_sum$annV7_noNum != 'Undif Carci')
ggplot(df_sum, aes(x = annV7_noNum, y = sum_acc, pattern = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme_classic()+
   ylim(c(0, 20)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

```

################### violin at single cell


```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_summary <- df_cms %>%
  group_by(cn, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_sumSR = mean(sumSR, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sumSR = sd(sumSR, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

library(ggplot2)

p <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = cn, y = mean_sumSR, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_sumSR - sd_sumSR, ymax = mean_sumSR + sd_sumSR),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                width = 0.2) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = c("control" = "#999999", "disease" = "#E41A1C")) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Mean ± SD of sumSR") +
  xlab("CN") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
p
```
